name: Utsuro Hinohara
source:
The past master of the Mirror World and Mishiro's cousin. She initially manifests as a hostile, red-eyed ghost with black hair that pursues Mishiro throughout the distorted realms. 

[spoiler]In life, Utsuro was born out of a tragic family situation and was eventually killed by her own mother, Tamaki. Her death devastated her only friend, Yuzu. After her death, Utsuro became the original creator and ruler of the Mirror World, trapping wandering souls inside it.[/spoiler]
translation:
The past master of the Mirror World and Mishiro's cousin. She initially manifests as a hostile, red-eyed ghost with black hair that pursues Mishiro throughout the distorted realms. 

[spoiler]In life, Utsuro was born out of a tragic family situation and was eventually killed by her own mother, Tamaki. Her death devastated her only friend, Yuzu. After her death, Utsuro became the original creator and ruler of the Mirror World, trapping wandering souls inside it.[/spoiler]
